source: 02_SOURCES/ALL_198_SHEETS.json (sheet names, visibility and formula-XML-node counts only)
method: Sheets are grouped into families by normalising the sheet name: the _GHG/_CO2 suffix, whitespace, the method name inside 各種パラメータ(...), the (2)/(3) suffix and the 排出係数固定/変化 qualifier are removed. Grouping uses names only.
evidence_level: OBSERVED for names and node counts; the calculation content of every family is NOT_INSPECTED (original formula bodies are not available in this repository or this study environment).
warning: Formula XML node counts are a proxy for how often a calculation is repeated in the original workbooks. They are not execution time, not a count of distinct formulas, and not evidence that sheets with equal names or counts contain identical formulas.
